div0.head: Oidedoiged MS. Chuind Cētchathaich annso
div0.p:
Eochaid Bēlbuidi mac Feidlimid Rechtmair brāthair Cuind. Luidside i crīch nUlad ar comairci do theiched Chuind a brāthar, ūair fa dobēsach dīchoisc Eochaid, &ersir; romillead rīgi &ersir; smacht a brāthar. Is andsin immorro cartaiscarrthais MS. Cond cūicer fear grāda dō co rīgaib Ulad conā beith Eochaid Bēlbuidi aco, no co mbetis fo sobēs. Ba hīad so in cūicer techtairead luidsead frisin .i. Foitin Forbair mac Fēigi Ēchtaig, &ersir; Ēnda mac Dega Laigen, &ersir; Ailill mac Fingein meic Luchta, &ersir; Tibraidi Tūaithebrach mac Cleitig, &ersir; Asal mac Forandāin a Formaīl. &ersir; luidsed fothūaid rompo a Temraig. Is andsin do hindised dōib Eochaid Bēlbuidi do beith ac seilc a Slēib Breg, &ersir; do marbsad in tEochaid andsin, ūair nī frīth neach mailli fris acht a chū, ut poeta dixit:
Eochaid Bēlbuidi robīth
i cath Chomair, ūada a &fdot;ich,
ūair nī roibi neach 'na dū,
frīth hē i mbāegal is a chū.

Rob olc didiu la rīgaib Ulad in gnīm sin &ersir; adubradar nach gēbdais coma ina sarugud acht a marbad, ūair nīr gobad rompo. Ar āi dorondad sīd eturru &ersir; Cond. Ba hīad rīga Ulad in tan sin .i. Cairpri Gnāthchorad mac Māil meic Rochraidi &ersir; Bresal mac Briūin. Adbathadur iar sin drem dīb. Adbert Breasal no Tibraidi mac Māil nā gēbad sīd, ūair nīr lam beith i nUltaib deisidēn ar ecla Chuind &ersir; la hecla rīg Ulad tre &fdot;oirēicin Chuind forro side.

Is ed doroindi Tibraidi dul i nAlbain co rīg Alban .i. co Failbe Findloga &ersir; bāi trī bliadhna aici side. Is andsin tuc rīg Alban comairli dō .i. tīachtain i nĒrind &ersir; sīd do dēnam re Cond. Donīth uili amlaid sin. Rāidid Ulaid fris beith sīdachsidaich MS. re Cond. Adbert somSomething seems omitted here. do dēnam &ersir; nīr lam tīachtain ar comairci no a āenur co Cond, conid hī comairli doroindi tīachtain i rechtaib ban copchaillech d' indsaigiddinsaidig MS. Chuind. Is and bāi Cond in tan sin i tūaithemairtuaith themair MS. ic urgnum Feisi na Temrach &ersir; baidsi tūaith Themrach, &ersir; ba fūathad do Chond in tan sin. Is and doroindi Tibraidi andsidi Cond do marbad, ūair ba ūathad dō &ersir; ba līnmar do Thibraidi, conad amlaid sin īarum do marbad Cond.
